title: Ɛnne a Ɛko Tia Atoro Nsusuwii
intro: Wɔtetee ɔkra nokwafo bi wɔ aguadifo ne aguadifo mu wɔ asase bi a na wɔdan nsenia na wɔtew susudua so. Saa onipa yi nkutoo gyinaa ɔman mũ bi a wonni nokware, na ɔfrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ atɛntrenee na wɔnsom Nokware Nyankopɔn Baako no. Ɛwom sɛ na nkrasɛm no mu da hɔ na ɔfrɛ no teɛ de, nanso nkurɔfo no ampene so sɛ wobetie na wohyiaa nkrabea a ɛyɛ hu. So wubetumi ahu saa ɔbɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔhotefo yi afi Kur’aan mu?
clues: Wɔsomaa me sɛ ɔbɔfo kɔɔ nkurɔfo bi a na wɔn asetrade di dwuma wɔ aguadi ne aguadi ho.
Ná wonim me nkurɔfo wɔ asase no so nyinaa sɛ wɔma nneɛma tiawa na wosisi nneɛma a wɔde kari ade.
Wɔsan nso bɔɔ akwantufo a na wɔwɔ kwan so no hu na wɔtrɛw adifudepɛ mu wɔ asase so nyinaa.
Mehyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnsom Allah nko ara na wɔnni nokware koraa wɔ wɔn nkitahodi a wɔne afoforɔ di mu.
Wɔpoo me nkrasɛm no na wohunahunaa me sɛ wɔbɛpam me ne wɔn a wɔne me gye dii no afi asase no so.
Allah nam N'ahummoboro so gyee me ne m'akyidifoa no nkwa, wo abere a asotwe a epira kyeree adeboneyofoo no.

trial.label: Me Nkurɔfoɔ Bɔne
options: Nsisi wɔ nneɛma a wɔde kari ade ne nea wɔde susuw nneɛma mu
Abantenten a ɛkorɔn a wɔresi a ɛne wim hyia
Yoma abere a wɔhwehwɛ fi ɔbotan bi mu
Ɔhwee adiyifo a wɔsomaa wɔn kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn no
Mmabaa nkokoaa a wosie wɔn nkwa mu
trial.answer: Nsisi wɔ nneɛma a wɔde kari ade ne nea wɔde susuw nneɛma mu

outcome.label: Wɔn Awiei
options: Nteɛm a ɛyɛ hu gyee wɔn anadwo
Nsuyiri kɛse bi memee wɔn nyinaa
Mframa a ɛyɛ nwini a ano yɛ den sɛee wɔn
Abo a wɔde dɔte a wɔato tɔe guu wɔn so
outcome.answer: Nteɛm a ɛyɛ hu gyee wɔn anadwo

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
